description: React component for a Guardrail Testing Playground UI, including guardrail list, search, selection, and testing functionalities.

classes.name: GuardrailItem
classes.description: Interface representing a guardrail item with optional id, name, parameters, info, and timestamps.

classes.name: GuardrailTestPlaygroundProps
classes.description: Props interface for the GuardrailTestPlayground component, including list, loading state, token, and close handler.

classes.name: TestResult
classes.description: Interface for test result data including guardrail name, response text, and latency.

classes.name: TestError
classes.description: Interface for test error data including guardrail name, error object, and latency.

methods.name: toggleGuardrailSelection
methods.description: Function to toggle selection of a guardrail by name.

methods.name: handleTestGuardrails
methods.description: Async function to test selected guardrails with provided text, updating results and errors, and showing notifications.
